mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and 60 degrees out by Fireman's Park.

In city news, the Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to manage future development. Additionally, the city is reminding residents to subscribe to the digital newsletter to stay informed on local projects.
There is plenty to do, with the Downtown Farmer's Market and Lake Lou-ee's pizza night happening today. Tomorrow, you can head to ART House 360 or catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing.
On September 28, officers responded to a collision on CTH-PB where a 71-year-old man was cited for failing to keep his vehicle under control.
You can enjoy Turtle Cheesecake as the flavor of the day, and please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
